_readme: Phase 1 endpoint registry. Every QAD endpoint any step calls, segregated by
phase/case. Nothing here is hardcoded in application code — code resolves an
`source` cites where each entry was READ FROM, so no entry is taken on trust:
aux_web_version/...:N  = read out of the AUX reference implementation
BRIEF/jef-contract     = the decompile of qad-java-sse-vscode 1.0.10, listed
in the build brief as confirmed and exercised live
`classification` is the static-vs-dynamic split, AWAITING USER CONFIRMATION:
static  = identical across environments (QAD platform constants)
dynamic = changes per environment (lives in config/environment.json or .env)
`status`: confirmed = read from code or the confirmed contract
unvalidated = correct for AUX's environment, not yet exercised

_comment: (aux_web_version/backend/qad_client.py:57,:65) where its base is a bare
host:port. The Adaptive base URL already carries its context root
(.../clouderp), so `clouderp` occupies the same slot `qad-central` does.
Adaptive therefore needs NO extra prefix — matching the confirmed JEF
contract's {envUrl}api/qracore/... form. context_root is a setting, not a
literal, precisely so this never has to be guessed again.
context_root is DELIBERATELY ABSENT HERE — it is per-environment and lives
only in config/environment.json. Defining it in two files would be the same
drift defect the audit flagged in AUX's duplicated step tables.

auth._comment: Used by every write in every case. AUX re-fetches a token before EVERY write (7x per Case-1 run) and never refreshes on 401.

endpoints.label: Acquire bearer token
endpoints.notes: Credentials travel in the QUERY STRING, not a JSON body. AUX does not URL-encode the password (aux_web_version/backend/qad_client.py:42-53) — Adaptive must.

endpoints.label: Refresh bearer token
endpoints.notes: NOT implemented in AUX — AUX has no token cache and no 401 retry. Included because the JEF contract confirms it and Phase 2's long-lived gated runs will need it.

case1_new_bc._comment: New business component from scratch. Step numbers are AUX's current numbering; see QUESTIONS.md Q-D — two work units below have no step identity and will get sub-step ids in Phase 2.

endpoints.label: Creating Business Component in QAD
endpoints.notes: First QAD write of the run. Also re-called by step 4 (auto-fix retry) at pipeline.py:476.

endpoints.label: Dropdown wiring — read enriched metadata
endpoints.notes: QAD's Entity Builder needs two saves: GET the enriched metadata, mutate, POST it back. Emits under step 3 today — no identity of its own (Q-D).

endpoints.label: Dropdown wiring — write data-list back
endpoints.notes: Hard-fails the run on error — exactly the kind of step a human gate should show.

endpoints.label: Registering event handlers in QAD
endpoints.notes: AUX hardcodes eventHandlerType=BEFORE and appliesTo=WEB in the PAYLOAD (prompts.py:259). Phase 5 needs these parameterised — four base classes and three timings, per PHASE0_SUMMARY.md.

endpoints.label: Lookup creation
endpoints.notes: NEVER REACHED in AUX — the live path is behind a dry_run guard. Emits frames with no step/total/name keys at all (Q-D).

endpoints.label: Deploy — check for warnings
endpoints.notes: AUX DISCARDS this response — never assigned, never checked (pipeline.py:739). Adaptive must surface it at the Phase 4 gate.

endpoints.label: Deploying Business Component
endpoints.notes: Terminal write for case 1. Phase 4 gates this behind explicit approval; dry-run default.

case2_embedded._comment: Embedded BC. Shares bc.create / bc.metadata.* / deploy.* with case 1 — same endpoints, different call sites. Only the endpoints UNIQUE to this case are listed here.

endpoints.label: Building relations to parent entity
endpoints.notes: The step that makes it embedded. cardinality MANYTOONE; AUX uses a hardcoded UUID prefix for relationID. The grid is STRUCTURAL for MANYTOONE — a panel would need a ONETOONE redesign.

case3_serverside_jef._comment: Server-side, Phase 6. Adaptive uses JEF (Java/Maven). AUX's SSS endpoint is recorded under `not_ported` below and is NOT carried across — decision 6 of the brief.

endpoints.label: Download dependency jar
endpoints.notes: Returns application/java-archive. Currently FAILS on the Adaptive environment ('Downloading of core libs failed') — see PROGRESS.md deferral D5.

endpoints.label: Deploy extension jar
endpoints.notes: multipart/form-data, form field name `files`. Success judged ONLY on HTTP .ok — no submitResult envelope. WHOLE-JAR REPLACEMENT: deploying from an incomplete copy silently erases everything not in that copy. No undeploy command exists.

endpoints.label: Regenerate proxies
endpoints.notes: UI-only, not in plugin 1.0.10. Currently returns HTTP 500 on the Adaptive environment — deferral D5.

phase5_event_handlers._comment: Phase 5 — embedded event handlers on the parent BC. The read path below is the single most valuable artefact recovered in Phase 0: it is an EXISTING, in-repo read-back of a handler on a QAD-STANDARD parent view.

endpoints.label: Read existing event handler on a parent view
endpoints.notes: NOTE THE CASING: viewURI here, but viewUri on the entity endpoints. Response is data.eventHandlerV2s[] — an ARRAY, so 'exactly one row per 4-tuple' is INFERRED, not confirmed (VERIFICATION_ROUND2.md, B1 flag 7). Carries `concurrencyHash`, the optimistic-locking token that makes read-modify-write possible. eventHandlerType is BEFORE | AFTER | PRIMARY.

endpoints.label: Update an existing handler in place
endpoints.notes: Payload echoes `uri` + `concurrencyHash` from the read. NEVER RUN — this is a WRITE against a standard QAD parent view and needs explicit greenlight (QUESTIONS.md Q-L). Phase 5's chosen strategy is a NEW Pre/Post handler, which does not need this at all.

not_ported._comment: Recorded so it is a NAMED deferral, not a silent omission (working rule 6). AUX keeps SSS; Adaptive uses JEF. Not a toggle — decision 6 of the brief.

endpoints.label: AUX server-side scripting deploy
endpoints.notes: appSeq=0 and fileSeq=3 are UNEXPLAINED LITERALS copied verbatim from the VS Code extension — nothing in the AUX repo derives them. Moot for Adaptive: JEF replaces this path entirely.
